The image shows diced cooked chicken breast in a large stainless steel mixing bowl. The bowl looks about 25-30 cm across, and the chicken covers a patch of roughly 10 cm by 10 cm.

There are about 40 pieces, each around 2 cm across and 1 cm thick, so roughly 3-4 cm³ each. That comes to about 140 cm³ of chicken, or around 100-150 g allowing for gaps between pieces.

Cooked chicken breast runs about 165 kcal per 100 g. I'll use 110 g, which gives about 180 kcal.
